name: Die Oord
description: A holiday town on the coast. Families who have been camping at the same caravan park for generations. Children playing on the beach. Braai under the trees. Everything is idyllic - until a body washes up on the beach.

videos.title: Welkom In Kalfiebaai
videos.overview: Martie and Paul's summer vacation takes a dark turn when a masked robber hits the camp. The feeling remains that something worse awaits.

videos.title: Meneer Seerust
videos.overview: There's a body on the beach. The police are looking for answers and the camp is looking for scapegoats. A sign from the past makes Martie wonder if an old pattern is repeating.

videos.title: Prediker 2.0
videos.overview: Friends become suspects. Martie makes a new discovery. In Seerust, alibis are cheap and the truth is expensive.

videos.title: Jammerlappie
videos.overview: A small clue causes big trouble. Drikus' story begins to slip, and Elsabé's confidence falters.

videos.title: Geheime
videos.overview: Martie and Brandi search in different directions. Seerust has more than one secret to hide.

videos.title: Verslawing
videos.overview: What Paul can't remember makes Martie doubt. Juanita and Drikus get into trouble.

videos.title: Leuens
videos.overview: New versions of the night emerge. The more people talk, the less the puzzle pieces fit.

videos.title: Rigter
videos.overview: The pressure builds to breaking point. A plan fails, and Rigter decides how it should end.

videos.title: Stille Waters
videos.overview: Still waters begin to stir. The truth about the traumatic night is coming closer to the surface, and the impact affects everyone.

videos.title: Onder Draai Die Duiwel
videos.overview: The truth does not bring salvation, only consequences.
